title: Data Governance & Privacy Policy
description: Data collection, processing, storage, and retention policies aligned with Indian IT Act and global privacy standards. All personal data is minimized and purpose-limited.

sections.heading: Data Collection
sections.body: Only data necessary for stated institutional purposes is collected. Explicit consent is obtained for all personal data.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Personal data is retained only as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, or as required by law.
